# Cosmic Refractions: Seeing God's Beauty in Brokenness
## Scripture
"In him was life, and that life was the light of all mankind. The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it." - John 1:4-5

## Reflection
Just as the Earth's atmosphere refracts light, bending it into breathtaking displays of color and beauty, our brokenness can refract God's light, revealing His beauty in unexpected ways. The Northern Lights, or aurora borealis, are a stunning example of this phenomenon. As charged particles from the sun interact with our atmosphere, they create an otherworldly display of light and color. Similarly, when we surrender our brokenness to God, He can transform it into a radiant reflection of His love and redemption.

## Prayer
Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for the beauty that can emerge from brokenness. Just as the Northern Lights illuminate the darkness, may Your light shine through our frailties and weaknesses, revealing Your glory and majesty. Help us to surrender our brokenness to You, that You may refract Your light through us, touching the lives of those around us. May we be beacons of hope, reflecting Your beauty and love to a world in need. Amen.
